topic: The white-label client portal — what a Sanad office's clients see when they log in
format: Compare 'how most Oman businesses do X today' with 'how SmartPRO Hub customers do X'
post:
Most Oman businesses send clients a WhatsApp message when their work permit is ready. SmartPRO Hub customers give them a login.

That difference matters more than it sounds.

When a company works with a Sanad office running on SmartPRO Hub, their HR manager or ops director gets access to a branded client portal — their logo, their colors, their language preference.

Inside: every employee's visa status, work permit expiry, document uploads, and open requests. Updated in real time. No chasing. No "I'll check and get back to you."

We built this because Sanad offices were burning hours every week on status calls that never should have happened. And their clients — HR managers juggling 50+ employees — were completely in the dark between those calls.

The portal fixes both problems at once.

Clients see exactly what's in progress, what's pending from them, and what's done. The Sanad office stops being a black box and starts looking like the professional operation it already is.

One source of truth. Bilingual Arabic and English, so nobody gets left out of the loop.

What does your client communication process look like today — email, WhatsApp, or something else?
